Review healing proposals

Usage:
  kaab proposals [command]

Available Commands:
  approve     Approve a proposal; --promote publishes it as a new version
  list        List proposals (pending by default)
  reject      Reject a proposal
  show        Print a proposal

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for proposals

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)

Use "kaab proposals [command] --help" for more information about a command.
